purpose: Evaluate whether one unified new-position entry model produces Taiwan-market entry ranges that are both reachable/executable and useful after costs, without horizon labels, future information or fabricated inputs.

required_data.daily_ohlc: legally reusable, provenance-identified TWSE/TPEx daily OHLC with sufficient history for all frozen factors
required_data.security_master: historical supported-security classification; do not apply the ordinary-stock model to unknown instruments
required_data.corporate_actions: ex-right/ex-dividend, capital reduction, split, initial-listing/reference-price discontinuities
required_data.risk_states: attention/disposition/suspension and other model-relevant restrictions valid for each target session
required_data.institutional_and_credit: only legally reusable and historically date-aligned institutional, margin and short data used by the frozen formula
required_data.market_context: historically verifiable US-market, TAIFEX TX and international-event context available before the target Taiwan session

signal_contract.information_cutoff: every input must have been available before the target Taiwan trading session under the frozen production schedule
signal_contract.target: the next legally tradable Taiwan session after the latest fully verified input set
signal_contract.entry_range: one model-estimated price interval rounded to the applicable Taiwan tick size; no short/mid/long alternatives
signal_contract.deep_support_rule: a distant support level is not an actionable entry range merely because it has attractive forward returns when touched
signal_contract.unknown_context_rule: if any required 9+3 input is unavailable or unverified, no numeric entry recommendation is generated

execution.reachability_definition: a signal is counted as reached only when the target-session or frozen execution-window market range actually intersects the precomputed entry interval under information available at signal time
execution.fill_rule: use a conservative deterministic execution rule frozen before OOS; daily bars may not assume a favorable intraday path that cannot be proven
execution.unfilled_signal: record as unfilled and keep it in reachability/fill-rate statistics; never delete it from the denominator
execution.price_limits_and_ticks: apply Taiwan tick size, reference price, applicable price limits and known special trading restrictions

decision_metrics: net outcome per signal including unfilled signals

split_and_statistics.split: chronological development period followed by untouched OOS period
split_and_statistics.walk_forward: required when enough licensed history exists
split_and_statistics.universe: survivorship-safe TWSE+TPEx supported common-stock universe with industry and liquidity coverage
split_and_statistics.confidence_intervals: bootstrap or another documented clustered resampling method

required: minimum OOS signal and security counts pass
no material look-ahead or survivorship defect found
production formula hash/version matches tested formula
entry range reachability/fill performance meets the pre-frozen operational threshold
net-of-cost outcome per signal is not materially worse than frozen baselines
no catastrophic tail-risk deterioration relative to baselines
confidence index calibration passes on untouched OOS data
prohibited: declaring PASS from post-fill win rate alone
retuning the entry interval after seeing untouched OOS
using future session high/low to construct the entry interval
converting INSUFFICIENT to PASS because the UI needs a price
